name: DSM compression
description: Direct Strength Method column strength (AISI S100 / AS/NZS 4600): Pne, Pnl, Pnd and Pn from the section's signature curve and first yield.

name: Rounded C / Z section
description: A lipped or plain C or Z section with rounded corners, meshed as CUFSM's template does, with its properties from the engine; offered to the analysis for you to use or dismiss.

name: Thickness study
description: How local and distortional buckling of the current section change with the sheet thickness, and the thinnest thickness that meets a target: a full engine solve per thickness, log-scale charts, a table, the section drawn at its yield stress, and the result offered back to the analysis.
